summary: Examples of host_list with IP addresses, DNS names, and localhost with a trailing comma and local connection.
questions: How do I run an ad hoc command against two IPs without an inventory file?
How do I run a playbook against localhost only?

answer_card.title: host_list examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible -i '10.10.2.6, 10.10.2.4' -m ping all
ansible -i 'host1.example.com, host2' -m user -a 'name=me state=absent' all
ansible-playbook -i 'localhost,' play.yml -c local
```
